entity.name: Icon Button
entity.description: A minimal icon-only button: a slotted icon plus a required accessible label. It has no built-in positioning, color variants, or sizes.

items.description: When the user needs to trigger an in-page action such as saving data or confirming a decision, with no room for a visible text label.
When the action navigates the user to a different page or URL.

alternative.rationale: Links carry native navigation semantics. Screen readers announce them as links, and browsers support open-in-new-tab.

items.guidance: Always provide a descriptive label attribute — it is the button's only accessible name.
items.rationale: The button has no visible text; without a label it has no accessible name at all.

items.guidance: Wrap the element to control position and size.
items.rationale: The component exposes no size, color, or placement variants by design.

agentDocumentBlocks.purpose: Trigger a user-initiated in-page action using an icon, with no visible text label.

items.description: Use icon-button for icon-only, in-page actions; use type-ref for navigation to a URL.

items.guidance: Do not use for navigating to a different page or URL.
items.rationale: Buttons signal actions and links signal navigation. Assistive technology announces each differently, and users rely on that distinction to predict what a control will do.
The button carries no visible text; omitting label leaves it with no accessible name at all.
